verdict.rationale: Offer management is a fair axis for an ATS like Lever, but the evidence pack never mentions offer letters, templated dynamic fields, offer approval routing, or e-signature. The onboarding form-creation and AI Form Builder items cover post-hire onboarding documents, not ATS-issued offers, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, offers go out from the ATS — templated offer letters with dynamic fields, approval routing, and built-in e-signature
